newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The People's Bank of China, the central bank, issues two sets of rules governing supervision of the financial sector and credit card settlement.
- Shanghai's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by a year-on-year 13.7 percent in the first half of 1997, the city's statistical bureau said.
- Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co will issue 166 million foreign currency B shares at $0.4073 each in Shanghai on Friday.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Growth of Shanghai's fixed asset investment cooled to a year-on-year 4.5 percent in the first half of this year, a fall of 42.9 percentage points against the same period last year.
- Shanghai's machinery exports rose by year-on-year 53.1 percent to 2.138 billion yuan in the first half of 1997, the biggest increase among all Shanghai's exports.
